item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q018_tal_effector_repeat_lengths","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, all three entries are domains explicitly assigned SCCS a.298.1.1 and converge on TAL (transcription activator-like) effector family sunid 267609: d2kq5a_ is a 51-residue PthA crystallized fragment from Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. citri, d3v6pa_ is a 373-residue dHax3 repeat array from Xanthomonas, and d4cj9a_ is a 752-residue BurrH array from Burkholderia rhizoxinica. TAL effectors are tandem-repeat proteins, so sequence length can vary greatly through repeat-copy-number differences and construct/domain boundaries while the homologous all-alpha repeat unit and its left-handed alpha-alpha-superhelical assembly remain conserved; the 51-residue PthA construct represents only a small repeat fragment, whereas dHax3 and BurrH contain much longer arrays. Family membership is the relatively strong claim of close homology here; a.298.1 is the broader TAL effector-like superfamily (probable common ancestry), a.298 is the left-handed alpha-alpha-superhelix fold (shared architecture alone would not prove homology), and class a merely denotes all-alpha proteins. This assignment does not justify transferring DNA-target specificity, identical biological function, or full-array geometry among PthA, dHax3, and BurrH: repeat-variable residues and array context control recognition. Likewise, the short PthA fragment is suitable as a local repeat-scaffold template but not automatically as a representative or full-length template for the 373- or 752-residue arrays; repeat type, copy number, terminal context, and overall curvature should guide template and representative selection.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d2kq5a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d3v6pa_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d4cj9a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/264989","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/265556","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/265996","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267704","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267705","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267706","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267645","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267646","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267647","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267609","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267596","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267589","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d2kq5a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d3v6pa_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d4cj9a_?release=2.08"]}]}
